concerns.text: T008 hardcodes a single dataset source ('zjunlp/UV-Vis-ML') and mandates a hard failure if 'lambda_max_exp' is missing. This violates spec.md FR-001 (allows PubChem/SDBS) and plan.md Phase 0/Plan Fallback (allows reframing SC-001 if only computed values exist). The task silently weakens the spec's flexibility and blocks the fallback strategy.

T019 mandates halting execution if test set n < 50. This contradicts plan.md Phase 3 and spec.md SC-001/Assumptions which define a fallback strategy: 'report effect size (delta MAE) as descriptive, not hypothesis test' when power is low. The task enforces a hard stop where the spec requires a graceful degradation, violating the plan's risk mitigation.

T009 instructs to 'reframe SC-001' if only computed values exist. Tasks cannot alter Success Criteria (SC) defined in the spec; they must implement the logic to detect the condition and log the limitation as per plan.md. The task description implies a scope creep (changing the spec) rather than implementing the spec's defined fallback behavior.

T027 requires aggregating 'sc001_status' into metrics.json. However, T016 (which calculates this) and T019 (which may halt execution) create a dependency conflict. If T019 halts the pipeline due to low power, T027 cannot run, yet the spec requires a 'low power' result (descriptive stats) to be recorded. The task list lacks a path to generate the required SSoT output in the low-power scenario defined in the plan.
